Deborah:

Deborah visits the house and a nearby park/waterfront to feel connected; she carries her mother’s pendant/amulet. They shared quiet sunsets at a park bench. In Sep 2023 she revisited the house and remembered her mother’s cooking and pineapple birthday cakes.
- Deborah teaches yoga and is passionate about helping her community; yoga helped her through a difficult period. She runs neighborhood classes, workshops/events for mindfulness, self-reflection, and self-care. Met neighbor Anna at yoga in the park (Jan 2023); they became close, supported each other, and Anna has a pendant for her late mother. Deborah also started a running group with Anna (Jul 2023), held community events (yoga, food stalls, live music), and ran a free gardening class with a neighbor on 16 Sep 2023. A yoga getaway was cancelled by a storm (early Sep).
- Routines: morning meditation/yoga/teaching; started morning jogging in a nearby park in Feb 2023; evenings with loved ones. Enjoys beach yoga, surfing, nature walks, forest trails, and reflecting by water. Favorite nature spot has a forest trail and beach. Shared advice: break tasks into smaller pieces, schedules/planners, Eisenhower Matrix, mindful breathing, breaks, stretching, sleep/self-care.
- Lost friend Karlie in Feb 2023; last photo together was from a hike the previous summer (photo described as riding a motorcycle). A friend who died had written “Let go of what no longer serves you.” Deborah also misses her mother’s old friends and cherished reconnecting with them.
- Pets: cats Luna (adopted from shelter; 5 in Aug 2023) and Max (mother’s cat, whom Deborah took in after her death; 8 in Aug 2023). Deborah says she dislikes dogs.

Jolene:
- Electrical engineering student; finished an electrical engineering project in Jan 2023 and later a major project, completed May 2023: solar-powered vehicle (photo). Had an engineering internship at a well-known firm by Jun 2023; struggled with work-life balance. Earlier built/designed a sustainable water purifier for a rural community, which gave her purpose. Long-term goal: engineering that benefits underserved communities, sustainability, renewable/solar energy, clean water, and social impact. Proposed volunteer program teaching STEM to underprivileged children via school/center workshops and engineer guest speakers (Feb 2023; not yet launched). Presented at a virtual conference and got positive feedback (Aug 2023); considered further internships. Aug 2023 prototype idea: affordable/productive aerial surveillance for emergency response/environment monitoring. Had major project setback/lost work files in late Jul 2023, causing distress; meditation helped her recover.
- Stress from exams/deadlines; used Pomodoro (25 min work/5 break), then bullet journal (Aug 2023). Deborah suggested schedules, task breakdown, Eisenhower Matrix. Jolene values yoga/meditation for calm, focus, balance; has practiced about 3 years (sporadically at first), likes savasana. Began trying mindfulness/gratitude after retreat. Uses candles, essential oils (lavender/rosemary), calming music. Likes Nils Frahm and Ólafur Arnalds.
- Partner/boyfriend: together 3 years as of 25 Feb 2023, not married; met in college engineering class and became friends first. Partner’s father taught determination; Jolene’s late mother told her never to give up. They game together (Detroit, planned Walking Dead, It Takes Two, Overcooked 2; she once won three large pizzas), do yoga, travel, and support each other. Bought partner a console gift on 17 Aug 2023. Both discussed deceased loved ones’ values. Planned meditation retreat together; traveled to Rio de Janeiro and tried yoga classes (Aug 2023), and later to a few-week meditation retreat in Phuket (reported 12 Sep), which taught her to enjoy the journey/present, relax, and balance studies. Planned camping/yoga and discussed coffee with Deborah; coffee date set for Friday at 5 the week after 8 Sep, but no confirmed meeting reported.

Both snakes calm her; she enjoys reptiles.
